question: According to Census of India 2011, which state in India has the highest female literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** has the** highest female literacy rate** in India according to the Census of India 2011, with a rate of **96.2%.**
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** has the** second-highest **female literacy rate with** 83.8%.**
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has a female literacy rate of **80.3%**, while **Maharashtra** has a rate of **77.4%.**
 
• **Female literacy rates** are an important indicator of a **state's development **and progress towards gender equality.
 
• Kerala's high female literacy rate is due in part to its strong focus on education and high levels of** social development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh** has made significant progress in female literacy rates over the years, with the rate increasing from **76.5% in 2001 to 83.8% in 2011.**
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has also made progress in **female literacy rates**, increasing from **68.5% in 2001 to 80.3% in 2011.**
 
• **Maharashtra **has a relatively lower female literacy rate compared to other states in India, but has made progress in recent years with the rate increasing from** 67.5% in 2001 to 77.4% in 2011.**
